mainEntity.name: Which service do I need if I own rentals in several LLCs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental property bookkeeping on the Growth plan. I keep separate books for each LLC and give you both per-entity and combined reports. Growth starts at $750 a month.

mainEntity.name: Do you do job costing for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. I set up each job in QuickBooks Online with cost codes for labor, materials, subcontractors, and equipment, so every job has its own profit and loss. I also track progress billing and retainage, keep a WIP schedule, and handle subcontractor 1099s.

mainEntity.name: Can you fix AppFolio and QuickBooks numbers that don't match?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That's the Systems & Integration service. I trace where the two systems disagree, fix the sync or mapping, and reconcile so the reports match going forward.
